name: atomic_settings
prompt: Fix settings.store.apply_updates and run the visible tests. Each nonempty input element must be exactly KEY=VALUE with no whitespace. KEY matches [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}. VALUE is true, false, or a canonical signed base-10 integer with no leading zeroes except zero. Duplicate keys use the last value. Return a new dict and never mutate current, including when any record is invalid. Reuse settings.parser.parse_value and remove the duplicate private value parser from store.py. Do not edit the tests or create unrelated files.
